      public Layout(String name, String metadataGroupName, Function<Interaction, GroupComponent> templateTreeGenerator, GuiSize size)
      Instantiates a new Layout.
      Parameters:
      name - the name
      metadataGroupName - the group name where metadata for this layout is stored. Defaults to layout name if null.
      templateTreeGenerator - the template tree generator is only called once with the defaultInteraction
      size - the size
